name: Content filters and DNS proxy
plain: Filters or blocks network traffic and domains system wide.
meaning: Lets an app block ads, malware and categories. iOS content filters see flows but not content on unsupervised devices; DNS settings are encrypted.

android.permission: Private DNS setting; VpnService for local filters
android.note: Many ad blockers use a local VPN.

ios.note: Safari Content Blocker works unsupervised; data filter needs supervision.

limits.headline: Can filter or block internet traffic and domains across the phone once you set it up
limits.user_action: You turn on a blocker app, pick a Private DNS, or tap Allow on the filter prompt
can: Block ads, malware and categories of sites
Route traffic through a local VPN to filter it (Android)
Use Safari content blockers on iPhone without supervision
cannot: See page content with an iPhone content filter unless the phone is supervised
Work before you turn it on in Settings or accept the prompt
Use the iPhone data filter on an unsupervised phone
limits.differs: Android uses Private DNS or a local VPN; iPhone uses Safari blockers, DNS settings and supervised only data filters.

story.what_it_is: Filters or blocks network traffic and websites across the whole phone.
story.for_you: You install an app that blocks ads, trackers or bad sites in every app and browser. Pages load faster and fewer ads show. A key or lock icon may appear in the status bar.
story.for_makers: Ad blockers, parental filters and malware guards need to see where traffic goes. The tool can block whole lists of domains. It also sees the sites you visit, so trust in the maker matters.

use_cases.example: A DNS blocker stops phishing and malware sites for the whole phone.
A parent blocks adult sites and social apps on a child's phone.
A blocker removes ads and trackers inside games and news apps.
A company blocks risky categories on staff phones.
A news reader loads faster with ads stripped.
A filter blocks game ad networks so free games play with fewer interruptions.
A privacy app shows which apps call which tracker domains.

story.android_note: Many ad blockers use a local VPN on Android.
story.ios_note: Safari content blockers work on any iPhone. A full network data filter needs a supervised device.

technical_bounds: iOS flow filter limited to supervised devices
